summary: Implemented a minimal static HTML website with a Python HTTP server that serves 'Hello World' and includes a health endpoint. Added security headers (Content-Security-Policy, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options) to mitigate common vulnerabilities. Provided Dockerfile for containerization and a test script to verify functionality.
findings: All tests passed: server responds with 200 on / and /health, serves HTML with correct MIME type, displays 'Hello World' text, and includes security headers. No security vulnerabilities detected in basic checks.
